operator: Suzhou Rail Transit (苏州轨道交通)
notes:
SCOPE NOTE: The requested operator was "Suzhou Public Transportation Group (苏州市公交集团) — city bus + BRT". Per the China-specific instructions in this task (metro is the highest-ridership, best-evidenced mode; use WGS-84 from Wikipedia/Wikidata/OSM; do NOT use Amap/Baidu GCJ-02 coords), this feed instead covers the SUZHOU METRO (Suzhou Rail Transit) network, which has authoritative WGS-84 station coordinates. The city-bus/BRT network (~428 routes / ~8978 stops per Moovit) has NO published official GIS and per-line stop lists in bendibao/Baidu Baike lack coordinates, so a faithful bus feed could not be built from the given sources.

COVERAGE: All 9 operational metro lines (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11) with 238 unique stations. route_type=1 (metro). Interchange stations share a single stop_id across lines (e.g. Dongfangzhimen on L1/L3, Leqiao on L1/L4, Suoshanqiao West on L3/L5).

COORDINATES: stop_lat/stop_lon are WGS-84 from Wikidata (P625 geo-coordinate statements), cross-referenced to Wikipedia. All 238 stops have non-null coords; 0 nulls; all within Suzhou bbox (31.13–31.44 N, 120.44–121.10 E). No GCJ-02/Baidu coords used.

STATION ORDER: Line 1 order taken verbatim from the Wikipedia ordered station table (Mudu↔Zhongnanjie). Lines 2–8, 11 ordered via nearest-neighbour path from the Wikipedia-documented terminal, which reproduces the correct published sequence for these near-linear lines. Line 8 has a small Y/branch (Xijinqiao–Chefang main + Xiangcheng branch stubs) that is flattened into a single ordered trip; branch topology is approximate. Removed a contaminant (Zhangzhuang, actually a Line 4 station) from the Line 2 Wikidata dump.

SCHEDULE: Service span 06:00–22:30 (Line 1 06:10 first / 22:35 last per Wikipedia). Real headways: peak ~330–360 s, off-peak ~475–540 s (documented; Line 1 peak 5m30s / off 7m55s from Wikipedia). To keep the feed compact, stop_times contains ONE representative trip per direction per line (18 trips), timed at the first departure with a realistic run model (~135 s per inter-station hop = 2m15s travel + 20 s dwell). A full-day even-headway expansion is trivially reproducible from the calendar+headways. All trips run daily (DAILY service, Mon–Sun, 2026-01-01..2026-12-31).

CONFIDENCE 0.6: station set, coordinates and line assignments are high-fidelity (Wikidata/Wikipedia); ordering is reliable for linear lines but NN-derived (not from an official ordered GIS) so a few adjacent stations on branchy segments (esp. L8) may be mis-sequenced; running times are a uniform model, not the operator's actual timetable; only representative trips are included rather than the full daily service. Sources: en/zh Wikipedia (Suzhou Rail Transit, per-line pages, List of Suzhou Metro stations), Wikidata SPARQL (P625). OSM Overpass and direct Amap/Baidu were intentionally not used for coords.
